policy: Prioritize high-fit, inspectable resources. Do not mass-submit the same pitch. Check each target's current contribution rules immediately before contacting them, preserve CBT Cards safety/evidence boundaries, and use the smallest canonical resource that fits the directory.

targets.name: dreamingechoes/awesome-mental-health
targets.evidence: Active curated mental-health list with an Applications section, existing CBT/privacy-focused apps, and documented contribution flow.
targets.fit_note: Pitch the free reviewed public practice library, not clinical treatment claims or an app-store install.

targets.name: theimpossibleastronaut/awesome-mentalhealth
targets.evidence: Curated mental-health resources list covering anxiety, self-help, mindfulness, and related resources; repository was active in 2026 search sampling.
targets.fit_note: Lead with browser-local free worksheets and reviewed educational scope.

targets.name: Agent Skill Exchange
targets.evidence: Curated Agent Skills catalog with a documented Submit a Skill flow and provenance/security review.
targets.fit_note: Use the portable reviewed-practice skill and link its immutable manifest/versioning and eval evidence.

targets.name: dmgrok/agent_skills_directory
targets.evidence: Quality-scored Agent Skills directory with a documented publish --submit path, maintenance tracking, and security checks.
targets.fit_note: CBT Cards has public docs, immutable versions, schemas, evals, and active maintenance evidence that map well to its quality criteria.

targets.name: block/agent-skills
targets.evidence: Goose Skills Marketplace source repository explicitly welcomes community skills through pull requests and validation.
targets.fit_note: Submit only if the current portable frontmatter can be adapted without weakening safety/publication boundaries.

targets.name: JPeetz/agent-skills
targets.evidence: Cross-platform Agent Skills collection accepting issues/PRs and requiring eval suites plus specification validation.
targets.fit_note: Strong fit after confirming their local packaging/eval conventions; CBT Cards already publishes eval datasets and portability checks.

targets.name: All-The-Vibes/skills-catalog
targets.evidence: Agent Skills catalog with documented new-skill contribution process and cross-assistant positioning.
targets.fit_note: Check category/domain fit first; their current catalog is engineering-heavy.

targets.name: openmodelsrun/skills
targets.evidence: Community-maintained skills registry with documented schema validation and PR contribution flow.
targets.fit_note: Their canonical format is structured YAML rather than portable SKILL.md; adapt metadata without claiming their registry has exercised CBT Cards runtime behavior.

targets.name: bbwdadfg/ai-agent-skills-index
targets.evidence: Daily-generated public index of Agent Skills with machine-readable metadata and links to upstream repositories.
targets.fit_note: First verify whether the public CBT Cards skill is automatically discovered before requesting manual intervention.

targets.name: lawrence3699/agent-skills-corpus
targets.evidence: Reproducible public Agent Skills corpus that records source metadata and publishes full text only for clearly licensed skills.
targets.fit_note: Metadata discovery is relevant now; full-text redistribution intersects open issue #7 and should not be encouraged until the public reuse license is deliberate.

targets.name: Minding Your Mind resource directory
targets.evidence: Public resource-submission form accepting national resources/services, with organization and mission fields.
targets.fit_note: Do not submit until organizational/contact eligibility is confirmed; present CBT Cards as educational/self-reflection material, not treatment.

targets.name: Mental Health @ Home resource directory
targets.evidence: Curated directory explicitly covering free mental-health workbooks, worksheets, CBT/DBT resources, apps, and coping tools.
targets.fit_note: High topical fit for free worksheets, but no verified submission workflow was found in the initial research pass; avoid unsolicited outreach until a current path is confirmed.
